phase_name: Shell-level verification of the chained-cd mechanism

objectives.description: Chained cd from foreign cwd to GLOBAL_ROOT observed correct
Separate Bash call confirms cd does not persist
--local path resolves to foreign/target repo, not global root
No-op path resolves correctly when already at GLOBAL_ROOT
Source/deploy identity re-confirmed for all three changed files (all now differ)

deviations.description: Used $SCRATCH/fake-foreign-repo instead of ~/Projects/cslib as the foreign cwd
deviations.reason: Avoid side effects in a real external repo; the plan's own wording uses ~/Projects/cslib only as an example ("e.g."). Scratch dir exercises the identical mechanism with zero blast radius.
